text: Pressing a key doesn't send a letter.
Under your keys is a grid of wires:
A small chip scans it hundreds of times a second,
powering one row at a time
Press ay, and its row and column connect.
The chip sends a scan code,
a number for that physical key.
Your operating system turns that number into a letter
That's why switching to azerty moves letters
Which keyboard layout do you type on?
